subject: FinSecure — next steps: DPA request & SCC module selection
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia@finsecure.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: FinSecure — follow-up and ask: DPA / SCC / SOC 2 status

Hi Olivia / Marcus,

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet your security and procurement leads. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the POC and procurement path.

Recap:
- Use case: secure, low-latency customer support summarization + redaction; some PHI in a small subset of workflows (we discussed scoped HIPAA obligations).
- Priority: data residency + auditability, predictable latency, and clear contract terms for data handling.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) SOC 2 status and any attestation/report you can share.
2) Preference on SCC module (Module 1: Standard vs Module 2: Processor-focused) and confirmation on whether FinSecure will act as Controller for the data in the POC.
3) Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can start ours in parallel).

Attachments: I attached our SOC2_Attestation_2026_Q2.pdf (summary attestation) for context — happy to provide the full report under an NDA if needed.

Proposed Redwood actions / next steps (we're aiming for a week turnaround):
- Send our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.docx) and call out SCC options for your legal team to review — Laura (cc) will own that track.
- Start the vendor questionnaire in parallel; if you can share yours we’ll populate and return within 3 business days.
- If helpful, schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call next week to resolve SCC/module selection and controller/processor alignment.

Please confirm: 1) SOC 2 availability, 2) SCC module preference, 3) whether you’ll be Controller for the POC.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan after I hear back.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Olivia Hart <olivia@finsecure.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T18:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinSecure — follow-up and ask: DPA / SCC / SOC 2 status

Sergio, thanks for the clear recap.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II, last attestation Q2 2026. I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire we use internally (FinSecure_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx).
- SCC: Our privacy team leans toward Module 2 (Processor-focused) because for the POC we expect FinSecure to be the Controller for customer data. We can confirm formally but that’s the starting position.
- DPA: Please send your DPA template (we prefer to review customer templates and then redline).

Timeline: we need procurement and legal sign-off to proceed with POC by mid-October. Can your team commit to returning a completed questionnaire and DPA within 5 business days?

Thanks — looping Marcus (procurement) on timeline details.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Hart
Head of Security Operations, FinSecure
olivia@finsecure.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinSecure — follow-up and ask: DPA / SCC / SOC 2 status

Thanks Olivia — that's helpful and aligns with what we heard on the call.

Plan from our side:
- Laura / Aditya: we’ll send Redwood_DPA_v3.docx today for your review. Laura, please flag any clauses we should surface to FinSecure ahead of the legal-to-legal call.
- I'll complete your vendor questionnaire and return it by EOD Thursday (2026-10-01).
- We'll confirm the SOC 2 summary is appropriate; if you need the full report we can provide it under NDA.
- For SCC selection: given you expect to be Controller in the POC, Module 2 seems reasonable — Laura, would you recommend any contract language changes specific to the Module 2 path?

Mutual action plan (suggested):
1) 2026-10-01: Redwood returns completed vendor questionnaire + Redwood DPA v3.
2) 2026-10-04: Legal-to-legal 30 min call to confirm SCC module and redlines.
3) 2026-10-11: Procurement sign-off / POC kickoff.

Olivia / Marcus — does that timeline work for your team?

—
Sergio
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Olivia Hart <olivia@finsecure.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinSecure — follow-up and ask: DPA / SCC / SOC 2 status

Thanks — looping in legal and privacy. A few quick notes from Redwood legal: 

1) Controller / Processor alignment: if FinSecure intends to be Controller for the POC data, SCC Module 2 is the typical route. We'll include a Module 2 annex in the DPA and call out any operational obligations (data deletion windows, allowed processing, subprocessors list).

2) DPA: I will send Redwood_DPA_v3.docx as an attachment to Sergio to share; it uses a Module 2 annex template. Expect one or two commercial redlines from FinSecure — we can triage those on the legal call.

3) SOC 2: the summary attestation is fine for initial procurement. If procurement or compliance need the full report, we can provide it under NDA. We'll also include a short SOC2_summary.txt with the control scope and last audit dates.

4) Vendor questionnaire: Sergio, please return the completed FinSecure questionnaire; Aditya and I will review technical answers and confirm whether we need to provide any additional encryption/service descriptions.

Suggested next steps: Sergio to send DPA and filled questionnaire today; Laura to propose 2x 30-min slots on 2026-10-04 for legal call.

—
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
(Attachments referenced in thread: SOC2_Attestation_2026_Q2.pdf (pdf), FinSecure_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood_DPA_v3.docx (docx))
